timeline.title: Generation 1 and a virtual win
timeline.text: Our first cars, with a Traxxas Fiesta chassis and Jetson TX2. The IFAC Grand Prix that year was raced in simulation, and we won it.

timeline.title: First physical win
timeline.text: Generation 1 wins the 9th Grand Prix in Prague.

timeline.title: Generation 2
timeline.text: New Traxxas Slash chassis and Jetson NX. Third place out of 38 teams in Philadelphia.

timeline.title: Podium in London
timeline.text: Second place out of 41 teams at ICRA 2023, the last race for Generation 2.

timeline.title: Generation 3 with Intel NUC
timeline.text: Fourth in Yokohama, second in Abu Dhabi and first place in Milano.

timeline.title: Our own lab
timeline.text: We got our own room before ICRA 2024 in Japan. After the renovation, we moved into the Autonomous Robots Lab of the Research Unit of Cyber-Physical Systems at TU Wien (Room PCEG13) in June 2024.
timeline.imageAlt: Sign of the Scuderia Segfault Autonomous Robots Lab, Room PCEG13, TU Wien

timeline.title: Generation 4
timeline.text: Back on the Fiesta chassis with an ASUS NUC 14 Pro.
timeline.imageAlt: Five Generation 4 race cars lined up on the floor

timeline.title: Atlanta
timeline.text: Fourth place at ICRA 2025 with Generation 4.

timeline.title: Hosting RoboRacer Vienna
timeline.text: We host the 27th RoboRacer Autonomous Racing Competition at TU Wien.

timeline.title: Generation 5
timeline.text: A new low chassis is in development in our lab.
